{{Current events|year=2019|month=01|day=24|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Disasters and accidents
* The city of [[Adelaide]], [[South Australia]], reaches its highest maximum temperature since 1939, reaching {{convert|46.6|C|F}} at around 3:36pm local time. This is the highest recorded temperature in any Australian state capital. The high temperatures have proven fatal for significant numbers of local animals. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-46981750 (BBC)]
* Three people die due to the severe storms in the [[Spain|Spanish]] region of [[Asturias]]. [https://elpais.com/politica/2019/01/24/actualidad/1548330040_397041.html (''El País'')]
;Politics and elections
*[[2018 Democratic Republic of the Congo general election]]
**[[Félix Tshisekedi]] is sworn in as the 5th [[President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo]], marking the first transition of power by an election in the country since it gained independence in 1960. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/01/felix-tshisekedi-sworn-dr-congo-president-190124132340652.html (Al Jazeera)]
*Brazilian [[Chamber of Deputies (Brazil)|legislator]] and LGBT rights activist [[Jean Wyllys]] announces he will leave his office and his country after death threats against him increase in number and intensity. Wyllys will be replaced by fellow [[Socialism and Liberty Party|PSOL]] politician [[David Miranda (politician)|David Miranda]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jan/24/jean-wyllys-brazils-openly-gay-congressman-leaves-job-country-amid-death-threats (The Guardian)]

;Law and crime
*Former [[First Minister of Scotland|Scotland First Minister]] [[Alex Salmond]] is charged with two attempted rapes and indecent assault. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/scotland-s-ex-first-minister-alex-salmond-reportedly-arrested-charged-n962096 (NBC News)]
*A gunman kills three people before committing suicide in [[State College, Pennsylvania]], United States. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/dead-critical-penn-state-shooting/story?id=60615842 (ABC News)]
